name: Duet Split-Screen
summary: Two video panels side by side in one vertical frame: the source clip on one half and a new reaction or performance on the other. TikTok added the Duet tool in 2018.

philosophy.core_thesis: The frame is a conversation: one original clip, one answer, both visible at the same time.
design_principles: Split the 1080 x 1920 px frame into two panels of 540 x 960 px at the centre, or into two halves of 1080 x 960 px.
Keep a 4 px gap in the page colour between the two panels.
Play both audio tracks from one timeline and sync the starts to the frame.
Mark the original creator with a 24 px handle label at the bottom left of its panel.
Give the reacting panel a 2 px accent border (#FE2C55) so the viewer sees who answers.
Keep captions in the dead band under the panels at 40 px, 2 lines at most.
Hold the cut rhythm at 1 cut every 2 s to 3 s on the answer side only.
anti_patterns: A single full-bleed shot with no second panel
Different aspect ratios in each panel
Large title cards that cover the clips

layout.grid_mechanics: Two equal video cells on a 2-column grid with a 4 px gutter; one caption band of 240 px below.
layout.whitespace_ratio: The panels take 80% of the height; the bands take 20%.
layout.alignment_rules: Cells are flush to the edges; the caption is centred under the join.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangles with 0 radius; a 2 px border on the answer panel; a 24 px pill label.

font_pairings.note: A slightly rounded sans that stays clear at 24 px.

hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for captions and medium (500) for handles.
Set captions at 40 px and handles at 24 px.
Put the caption in white with a 2 px black outline.
Prefix a handle with the @ sign.

color.palette_structure: A black frame with two bright video panels and one hot accent on the answer panel.
color.contrast_rules: White on ink gives 19:1; handle labels use dark text on a white pill at 17:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat ink ground; the video panels carry all the colour.
color.light_and_shadow: Even front light in both clips; no shared shadow across the join.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone screen split into two glass panes.
materiality.border_rules: A 4 px gap and a 2 px accent border on one pane.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; the join is flat.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid 24 px icons for duet, stitch and sound.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None; the two clips are the picture.

motion.transition_physics: Both clips start on the same frame; the answer panel slides in from the right in 250 ms at the start; the clips loop at 15 s to 60 s.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on a panel mutes the other panel and adds a 2 px white border.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels part of a conversation and wants to answer.

avoid_when: The message needs one uninterrupted image.
The source clip is not public or not licensed.

modifiers.how: Remove the second panel and fill the frame with one first-person shot.
Merge both clips into one cut sequence with speed ramps.
Replace the second panel with a person in front of the source image.

pack.why: A filled rounded family that fits the toolbar icons of a short-video app.

ground.why: The ground is two flat blocks that echo the two panels of the frame.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none border-2 border-[#FE2C55] bg-[#FE2C55] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white
